## What shipped

- **Declaration** — `axis_order` on every `camera_registry_targets.toml`
  + `dot_511_targets.toml` row (closed `lon-lat`/`lat-lon`; `lat-lon`
  on `nottingham_gb_cctv_cameras` and `mark43_cctv`); documented
  `lon-lat` default for synthetic targets only — a committed row
  missing the field fails `sig-connectors validate`.
  `jurisdiction_extents.toml` (new): a declared WGS84 bound per
  `(jurisdiction_scheme, code)` for all 85 in-use codes; per-target
  `extent` overrides where a jurisdiction bound is wrong-tier;
  `sig.unresolved` rows record a skip, never a silent pass.
- **Detection** (`connectors/dot_511.py`) — `assert_target_axis_order`,
  `_extent_tuple`/`jurisdiction_extents`/`declared_extent`,
  `detect_geometry_defect` over the raw interpreted pair BEFORE the
  parcel screen and tier transform. Precedence: `null_island` (within
  1° of (0,0)) → `axis_swap` (outside bound, transpose inside) →
  `sign_flip` (exactly one negated axis rescues) →
  `wrong_jurisdiction` (outside, unrescued). `extract_coordinate`
  applies the declared order to positional slots (`x`/`y`, GeoJSON
  `coordinates[]`); NAMED field pairs stay name-authoritative — a
  swapped named column flags, never silently relabels.
- **Emit** — `CameraRegistryEntry` carries `axis_order` +
  `geometry_defect`; a defect-marked entry emits a `geometry_defect`
  claim (class value + evidence block: observed pair, declared bound,
  `extent_ref`, detector build `sig.p35-16-geometry-detector/1`,
  detail) plus `camera_coordinate_source` (which read produced the
  withheld pair) and NO `camera_latitude`/`camera_longitude`; parcel
  screen records `unscreened` against a defective pair. Invariants
  fail closed in `__post_init__` (closed class set; no coordinate on
  a marked entry; never parcel-flagged).
- **Vocabulary** — `geometry_defect` in `predicates.yaml` (string,
  multi, IMMUTABLE NULL half-life, `never_resolve`, SKOS IRI) +
  regenerated `ontology/generated` + insert-only sqitch
  `vocab_geometry_defect` (predicate row + 20-genre
  `directness_matrix` rows at ruleset 1.0.0, `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`;
  revert refuses to drop a referenced row) + `dot_511_vocab.toml`
  allowlist entry (`vocab_version` 2026.10.17).
- **Correction pass** — `connectors/data/geometry_corrections.toml`
  (`sig.geometry-corrections/1`: the seven F-322 groups — Nottingham
  562, mark43 561, trafficops ~828/1430 CA→FL, gmh_emc GA→Mongolia,
  bangla BD→Singapore, oosgis NL→Belgium, dot_511_ga + fl511_fl
  null-island) is the declared authorization. `db/geometry_corrections.py`
  resolves scopes via the SAME bound machinery as the emit detectors
  (`geometry_correction_scopes`/`scan_extents`), plans per-subject —
  one `geometry_defect` marking claim citing the original coordinate
  claims via `derived_from_claim_ids`; provable `axis_swap` rows gain
  transposed `camera_latitude`/`camera_longitude` claims carrying
  `revises_claim` + `correction_reason='axis_swap'` — and reports
  dry-run by default. `--apply` writes through `PgClaimSink`
  (`is_replay`, chunked commits, content-digest idempotence), refuses
  before any write when the closed vocabulary is unregistered, and the
  out-of-scope flag scan counts defect-shaped subjects on other keyed
  targets (disclosed, never written). CLI:
  `sig-connectors geometry-corrections --dsn … [--apply]
  [--commit-chunk-size] [--code-commit]`.
- **Portal row-count truth** — `exports/manifest.py` `Artifact`
  + `exports/bundle.py`: `distinct_entities` (unique `entity_id`s)
  serialized beside `row_count` on entity-bearing tables, `None`
  where no entity column exists — rows are observation-level records
  and licence-conflicted entities split across compartments (ADR-092;
  P27.4); the pair is the disclosure, `row_count` alone never reads
  as a resolved census again.
- **ADR-210** — per-target axis-order declarations + the closed defect
  classes; `## Revisit trigger`; register row appended quiet-at-authoring;
  index + Appendix F regenerated; BL-085 owner mapping.

## Named gaps (deliberate, owned downstream)

- **The hosted correction write + read-back** — staged, not applied;
  the ticket's OM-19 re-run prompt is verbatim in the contract and the
  leg is queued in RETURN PASS (`P35.16-geometry-corrections-live`).
- **Wrong-jurisdiction corrections assert the defect, never a
  fabricated replacement** — `trafficops`/`gmh_emc`/`bangla`/`oosgis`
  rows are marked `geometry_defect`; no new coordinate value is
  invented (the evidence does not support one — SIG-IDENT-004).
- **Detector-flagged subjects outside the seven groups** — the apply
  pass counts and discloses them in the report
  (`flagged_outside_scope`); writing them is a future declared-scope
  decision, never an inferred write.
- **Defects needing fresh captures** — per the contract, such a row is
  marked + filed, never silently left; none of the seven groups needs
  re-capture for its marking.
